Estimated class proportions

classprobs.Rd

Estimated class proportions

Usage

classprobs(object, level = c("within", "between"))

Arguments

object

A fitted latentmix model.

level

Two-level models: "within" (default) for the individual-level class proportions (mean posterior over individuals), "between" for the probabilities of the KB between-level (cluster) classes.

Value

For LCA, LPA and growth models, a numeric vector of the K class proportions (classes ordered largest to smallest). For an LTA, a class-by-wave matrix; for a multigroup model, a class-by-group matrix (groups in the order of m$group_levels); for a two-level model the within or between proportions.

See also

fitstats(), classification_table(), conditionalprobs()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# estimated ACE class proportions
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4)     # 4 ACE classes, as generated
#> Starting Julia ...
classprobs(m)   # generating shares 0.52, 0.20, 0.17, 0.11 (largest first)
#> [1] 0.56010023 0.18552219 0.15563946 0.09873811
# }
